senses.gloss: to seize, join, bring into close contact.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 9:10">Kil. IX, 10</cite> <he>התּוֹכֵף וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="V00534"><he>תְּכִיפָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:30">Y. Ber. I, 2ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>מי שהוא תוכף סמיכה וכ׳</he> he that performs the acts of putting on the hand and of slaughtering in immediate succession (usu. <cite ref="O01097"><he>סָמַךְ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Taanit 13b:4">Taan. 13ᵇ</cite> <he>תְּכָפוּהוּ אבליו וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="A00157"><he>אֵבֶל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Moed Katan 17b">M. Kat. 17ᵇ</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 67">Gen. R. s. 67</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 63:16">Is. LXIII, 16</cite>) and where is Isaac? <he>מי … את מַתְכִּיפוֹ לאבות</he> he who said to him (Esau), decree persecutions over him,—wouldst thou join him to (include him with) the patriarchs?
